info.title: Submit Appeal Task
info.description:
#### Appeal Size Chart Verification
Initiates an appeal process for a product that was blocked during the listing phase due to a size chart verification failure.
This API is used when a seller believes their product was incorrectly blocked by our automated size chart validation system. The validation checks for three potential issues:

1. Whether the size chart contains all mandatory dimensions.
2. Whether the size chart covers all Stock-Keeping Units (SKUs) for sale.
3. Whether the numerical values within the size chart are valid.
   If the validation system detects an issue, the product listing will be blocked. By using this API, sellers can submit an appeal. If the appeal is approved, the block will be lifted, and the seller can re-list the product.
   Use the `[Appeal Status Webhook]` to monitor the appeal's progress, or pass the `appeal_id` to the `[Get Appeal Status API]` to retrieve the current status.
   Note:
* Please wait at least 5 minutes after submitting an appeal before checking its status via the API to ensure the data is synchronized.
* You can submit up to 50 appeals per day. Any requests exceeding this limit will be rejected.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: shop_cipher
parameters.description:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

field_name.description:
The target fields to appeal.
Possible values:
- APPEAL_MESSAGE_FIELD_SIZE_CHART

indicator_type.description:
The target indicator_type to appeal of this field.
Possible values:
- REQUIRED_DIMENSION：Does the size chart include all required dimensions?
- CONTAINS_ALL_SALE_PROPERTY：Does the size chart cover all sales attributes?""
- VALUE_RANGE_OUT_OF_RANGE：Are the value ranges in the size chart valid?

indicator_details.description: Indicator details of the products submitted for appeal

appeal_message.description: Details of the products submitted for appeal

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
